app_fee.value: The application fee is $70 and is non-refundable.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers go only to specific groups (McNair/Project 1000/GEM and similar scholars, US military and veterans), not to international applicants in general; programs may add their own rules.
fee_waiver.quote: If you are a McNair, Project 1000, GEM, or other scholar, you may be eligible for an application fee waiver. | Applicants who are currently serving in the U.S. Military or are Military Veterans who plan to apply for educational benefits under the GI Bill, receive a waiver of the application fee.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see the program record.

toefl_min.value: Only section minimums are set (no total): Writing 22, Speaking 23, Reading 21, Listening 17 for tests taken through 21 Jan 2026, and Writing 4.5, Speaking 4.5, Reading 4, Listening 4 on the new scale for tests after that. Some programs ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: Writing 22, Speaking 23, Reading 21, and Listening 17 | Writing 4.5, Speaking 4.5, Reading 4, and Listening 4

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall band 7 is the minimum for admission consideration; some programs ask for more.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum overall IELTS score for admission consideration is a bandwidth 7

english_waiver.value: The test can be waived only if your entire degree was taught in English, shown on the official transcript or in a registrar letter, and each request is reviewed case by case; India is not named as automatically exempt.
english_waiver.quote: The English proficiency test requirement may be waived for applicants who have completed their entire degree at an institution where English is the principal language of instruction. | Requests for waivers are reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

notes: Rules above are set by the School of Graduate Studies (New Brunswick); several departments state stricter or different rules in their program records.
